entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Musa Jafar oghlu Gasimli is an Azerbaijani historian, Doctor of Historical Sciences (1992), Professor (1998), founder and director of the Institute of Caucasian Studies at the National Academy of Sciences of Azerbaijan (2015–2024), corresponding member of the National Academy of Sciences of Azerbaijan (2017), member of the 4th, 5th, 6th, and 7th convocations of the Milli Majlis of the Republic of Azerbaijan, and Deputy Chairman of the Milli Majlis since September 23, 2024.

entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Musa Jafar oghlu Gasimli is an Azerbaijani historian, Doctor of Historical Sciences (1992), Professor (1998), founder and director of the Institute of Caucasian Studies at the National Academy of Sciences of Azerbaijan (2015–2024), corresponding member of the National Academy of Sciences of Azerbaijan (2017), member of the 4th, 5th, 6th, and 7th convocations of the Milli Majlis of the Republic of Azerbaijan, and Deputy Chairman of the Milli Majlis since September 23, 2024.
